name: smwpatches-move-layer-3-to-subscreen-fix-v1
title: Move Layer 3 to Subscreen Fix v1.1
description:
This lets you move layer 3 to subscreen via Lunar Magic without actually affecting the layer 3 status bar, which will always remain on top of everything, as usual. Note that this may be incompatible with other patches that hijack IRQ.

Kevin's update: now it works with recent SA-1 versions.

Mod edit (2024-02-03): Changed the default freeram define, as what was there before wasn't actually free.
